title: Waffled
description: This is a skyblock-style mod, but with waffles!
body:
Welcome to the waffled mod!

This is a skyblock-style mod, except you have to survive and progress on a platform made of waffles.

Explore custom dimensions and eventually defeat the final boss!

To begin the adventure, just execute the command "/waffle" after spawning into a world.

![Waffled: By Leoj_YT](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/6b0a7a921d3be4e3d201dbc453bafdf220831ad1.png)

Sometimes the command glitches and causes textures to become black squares, or it fails to generate the platform and drops you into the void, if that happens just do the command "/waffle" again.

After starting, you can get different waffle items by breaking the waffle blocks beneath you and crafting them into different things using the recipe book in your inventory. 

If you're stuck and can't progress, just check your advancements or recipe book. You could also go to the gallery images page of this mod, which can guide you on how to progress.

You can use this mod to play with friends or you could use it in a server!

This mod was made with MCreator.

Have fun :)

![Have fun :)](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/0124319566f6c454a2a24b31241ce1e1684c4002.webp)
